agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of Annual Report and Financial Statements. Shareholders approved the annual report, ratified the consolidated financial statements for FY 2025 audited by Mirawati Sensi Idris with an unmodified opinion, and granted full discharge to Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: Approval of Net Profit Usage. Shareholders approved no dividend distribution and no reserve fund allocation for the financial year ended 31 December 2025.
Agenda #3: Appointment of Public Accountant and/or Public Accounting Firm. Shareholders authorized the Board of Commissioners to appoint an independent Public Accounting Firm registered with OJK for the FY 2026 audit, with terms and honorarium set by the Board of Directors.
Agenda #4: Determination of Board of Commissioners honorarium and delegation of authority to set Director remuneration for FY 2026. Shareholders authorized the Board of Commissioners, with prior approval from controlling shareholders, to set remuneration for Board members, with distribution delegated to the President Commissioner, effective from the month after the meeting until the 2027 AGM.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of change in business activities from media and printing to holding company, including approval of the feasibility study by KJPP Kusnanto & Rekan, amendment to the Articles of Association to comply with OJK Regulation No. 17/POJK.04/2020, and granting authority to the Board of Directors.
Agenda #2: Approval of increase in authorized capital to IDR50 trillion divided into 500 billion shares at IDR100 each, and issued/paid-up capital to IDR21.556 trillion divided into 215.56 billion shares, through a Limited Public Offering with Pre-Emptive Rights (PMHMETD I), including amendment to Article 4 of the Articles of Association.
Agenda #3: Approval of granting authority to the Board of Directors to take all necessary actions for the implementation of the Rights Issue I, including determining share numbers, exercise price, record date, ratio, use of proceeds, timetable, preparing documents, submitting registration statement, depositing shares, and listing shares, with the exercise price subject to approval of the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #4: Approval of acquisition of 10,780 Series A shares, representing 49% of PT Borneo Prima's issued share capital, owned by IMR Asia Holding Pte Ltd, as a non-cash capital contribution (inbreng) under OJK regulations.
